about_the_game:
Max Beyond is a thrilling couch co-op action-puzzle game set in the multiverse.

Max, a kid with the ability to travel through the multiverses, is being held in the Axion medical facility. When two versions of Max from different realities collide, they trigger chaos across the multiverse, warping and distorting realities. Now, both Maxs must work together to repair the fractures in the multiverses and restore balance in the universe.

Key Features

Co-Op Gameplay: Team up with a friend and step into the shoes of two alternate reality versions of Max; work together to solve intricate puzzles, unlock doors, overcome challenging obstacles, and use quantum abilities to combat waves of evil robots & giant toys manifestations— before time runs out!

Unique Combat System: The combat system features a unique co-op combo mechanism that requires coordinated actions between players. Coordinate your attacks with your fellow Max to create powerful combos.  Unlock new abilities and power ups as each new level is 

unlocked!

Time Pressure: Both players must reach the portal before time runs out! Support one another to achieve your shared goal and ensure survival.

Dynamic Setting: Reality bending environments which shift unexpectedly.

About HaZimation

HaZimation Play is the video games development division of the production company - HaZimation, developing & producing high concept feature films, episodic and video games cinematics based on our proprietary pipeline utilising Unreal Engine.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
